CustomField.description: Origin marker set by the CRM Support Agentforce agent on every case it creates. Drives the per-topic KPI reporting required by the World-Class Agent Standard v2 §4 (deflection rate, escalation quality) in standard Salesforce reports. Set only by the agent's case-creation action; never by users.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked automatically when this case was created by the CRM Support agent on the user's behalf. Do not tick manually.
